name: Lord Inquisitor
description:
You have received a curse of judgment.

  • All Damage you take is increased by +2.

  • Your Defense is decreased by -1.

  • Once per turn, when you would recover Stamina, the user of this ability you may prevent you from doing so as a Free Action.

  • All attacks against you are considered Magical for the purposes of bypassing resistances.

This effect lasts until the end of combat, you become Incapacitated, or you are Dying. After you use this ability, you cannot use any ability with the Apex trait until you complete a Long Rest.
